title: The Best Home Car Charger on the Market: Power-Up with VOOL
seoTitle: Boost Your EV Experience: The Feature-Rich VOOL EV Charger
description: Discover the VOOL EV Charger: the best home car charger available for pre-order. What makes it so special? The whole package is greater than the sum of the parts...
body:
• VOOL EV Chargers offer comprehensive compatibility, long cables, many connectivity options, and efficient V2G features. These chargers work with almost all major EV brands and models, offering either 11 kW or 22 kW power options.
  • Chargers come with customizable design options to fit your personal style or business aesthetic.
  • Installation of VOOL Chargers is simple and modular, requiring just a standard three-phase power line and a mounting spot, whether for personal or commercial use. Additional accessories, such as a mounting post and hook, improve installation and storage.
  • The VOOL App enables efficient smart charging and remote control, allowing you to start/stop charging at your convenience, optimize cost by selecting preferred market rates, and track your savings and charging sessions.
  • VOOL's approach to EV charging combines functional design, ease of use, and innovative smart charging capabilities for a complete, cost-effective charging solution.

You're a man of specifics. You're looking for the best home car charger and surface-level product pages don't cut it for you. You want the nitty-gritty, the numbers, and the testimonials. If it was up to you, you’d have our lead engineer on speed dial. Well, consider this your handy guide to VOOL EV chargers.


This will save you some grunt work and package everything you need to know about our flagship product. Keep an eye out for reviews once we start rolling out pre-orders. As for the engineer's number, you’re out of luck there.

'Standard Features'

Standard features are for standard chargers. What we call standard, other EV chargers call extraordinary (we’ll get to the real bonuses in a bit).


You’ll get a 6.5-meter cable with a Type 2 plug, whether you opt for an 11 kW or 22 kW charger. You'll also have your pick of connectivity options, including Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, among others.


And for you efficiency hounds, V2G is standing by.


  • Power options: 11kW and 22kW
  • Compatibility: almost all EV brands and models
  • Charging cable: Integrated 6.5m
  • Connectivity: eSim, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, CAN Bus, PLC
  • OCPP: 1.6 compliant and 2.0 ready
  • V2G (Vehicle-to-Grid): Ready
  • Usage: Residential, Commercial, Fleet, and Public EV Charging


We won’t list all the details here, but feel free to check out our handy VOOL Charger spec sheet.

Bonus Features

You chose an electric car that suits you, so why shouldn't your charger? It'll greet you every day - choose its look and setup. These aren't just frills. We've engineered tools to enhance your charging routine.

EV charger panel designs

Industrial charm, chic minimalism, or forest fantasy? Choose one (or more) of our seven designs to reflect your personal style or create a striking, cohesive look for your business, EV fleet, or public charging area.

Mounting post

No wall near your parking space? No problem. Our EV charger mounting post is stylish and comes in a variety of colors, plus mounting the charger is quick and easy. Also, if you’re planning to monetize your parking spaces with public charging, our posts accommodate two chargers, doubling your revenue generation.

Charger hook

For those who prefer order over chaos, we present the VOOL hook. It's the perfect accessory for your 6.5m charging cable. Organization matters, whether you want to keep your garage uncluttered or offer convenience for customers in your multiple parking spaces.

EV Charger Installation – Personal or Commercial

Our chargers feature a modular design and installation process. To start, all you’ll need is a standard three-phase power line and a mounting spot. Our estimate? It takes roughly 10 minutes to install, but we’re familiar with our own equipment, so it’s easy for us to finish quickly.


Whether you're installing a VOOL charger in your garage or outside or scaling to meet demand, it's a cinch. Remember, our charger poles accommodate two chargers—that's two parking spaces.


As a pioneering company of electricians, engineers, and area experts, we’re certified to install electrical equipment safely and reliably. But sadly, we can't make house calls.


We advise you to hire a local electrician for your EV charger installation.

Netflix and Charge

Once you’ve got one of our chargers installed,  you’ll only be thinking about when to charge and how to do so at the cheapest rates. Good thing we made that easy too.

The VOOL App isn't just your on/off remote charger control - explore all the perks the app offers and why it deserves space on your home screen.


With our app, you can start and stop charging whenever you want — without leaving your Netflix binge session.

Charge Smarter, Not Harder

Smart Charging is great for anyone who doesn’t want to spend their nights making spreadsheets and calculating the costs of charging their EV.


We think it’s safe to say it’s great for everyone.


What is Smart Charging? Simply put, if you have a variable market price contract with your electricity company, this is where you’ll use the VOOL App to automatically charge your EV at the cheapest rates.


You’ll see the current market rates available during your charging period. You can opt to charge at the absolute lowest market rate, or if you need to make sure you’re charged by a certain time, but still avoid the peak hours, you can do that too.


You prioritize the criteria that make the most sense for that session. And, if you want, change that criteria every time you charge. All the while, the VOOL App tracks your savings and charging sessions for your review.


Once it’s set up, you can kick back and let Smart Charging take over.


You have the details, the descriptions, and the instructions.
